text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, rivaroxaban 15 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 147 tablets (15.2 days of supply), Corvale General holds 218 tablets (22.6 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 28 tablets (12.6 days). The top-ranked purchasing option is Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include rivaroxaban as of 2026-10-21. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited's registered plant (FEI 3004956904) received a NAI classification on 2024-07-26. The plant's inspection history shows VAI classifications in 2010, 2012, 2016, 2018, and 2020.

Our position: Current inventory across the three sites provides limited days of supply, with the lowest at Corvale Lakeside (12.6 days). No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation protocols. Procurement should proceed through standard purchasing channels using the ranked supplier list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as the primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Apotex Corp., Aurobindo Pharma Limited, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Changzhou Pharmaceutical Factory as backup sources; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at all three sites; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacy director to review supplier qualifications and inspection histories before first orders ship; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No allocation restrictions or clinical protocol changes at this time.
